Evidence-backed observations

These statements are generated from the same aggregates shown above. They are descriptive associations, not causal claims.

  • At budget 1, Winner-XFG - XFG edge attack and Winner-XFG - XFG feature mask have the highest observed ASR (10.0%, 30/300 eligible scored cases).
  • At budget 3, Winner-XFG - XFG edge attack has the highest observed ASR (23.3%, 70/300 eligible scored cases).
  • At budget 5, Winner-XFG - XFG edge attack and Winner-XFG - XFG feature mask have the highest observed ASR (13.3%, 40/300 eligible scored cases).
  • Random graph - edge add shows a non-monotonic budget-response pattern (2.0% at budget 1 versus 3.0% at budget 5).
  • Random graph - edge delete shows a non-decreasing budget-response pattern (0.7% at budget 1 versus 5.5% at budget 5).
  • Random graph - edge reconnect shows a non-monotonic budget-response pattern (1.3% at budget 1 versus 2.3% at budget 5).
  • Random graph - node add shows a non-decreasing budget-response pattern (0.0% at budget 1 versus 1.3% at budget 5).
  • Random graph - node attribute modify shows a non-decreasing budget-response pattern (1.3% at budget 1 versus 5.3% at budget 5).
  • Random graph - node delete shows a non-decreasing budget-response pattern (1.3% at budget 1 versus 6.4% at budget 5).
  • Winner-XFG - targeted subgraph injection shows a constant budget-response pattern (6.7% at budget 1 versus 6.7% at budget 5).
  • Winner-XFG - XFG edge attack shows a non-monotonic budget-response pattern (10.0% at budget 1 versus 13.3% at budget 5).
  • Winner-XFG - XFG feature mask shows a non-decreasing budget-response pattern (10.0% at budget 1 versus 13.3% at budget 5).
  • Random graph - node delete at budget 5 has the largest upward mean probability shift (+0.0153); Random graph - edge reconnect at budget 5 has the largest downward shift (-0.0588).
  • Scored coverage ranges from 74.3% for Random graph - node delete at budget 5 to 100.0% for Random graph - edge add at budget 1; effectiveness estimates should be read with that applicability difference.
  • Winner-XFG - targeted subgraph injection at budget 5 produces the largest mean absolute node change (15.00), while Winner-XFG - targeted subgraph injection at budget 5 produces the largest mean absolute edge change (20.00).
